Privacy Policy

Last updated: 16 May 2026

Chauffeur Emillan Katour ("we", "Emil", "our") respects your privacy. This policy explains what personal information we collect, how we use it, and your rights.

Information We Collect

We collect information you provide when contacting us (name, email, phone, travel dates), and standard web analytics data (pages visited, device type). We do not sell your data to any third party.

How We Use Your Information

To respond to tour enquiries, prepare personalised itineraries, confirm bookings, and send relevant travel information. We will never send unsolicited marketing without your consent.

Contact

For any privacy concerns, contact Emil directly at emil@chauffeuremillankatour.com.
